notes: Executable current Marsannay vineyard-management law. Rules are limited to machine-observable fields already represented by VineyardBlock. The Chardonnay-only Chablis pruning form and two-year Guyot-double establishment exception remain unmodeled rather than generalized.

constraints.notes: Rows require >=9,000 vines/ha, <=1.25 m row spacing and >=0.50 m in-row spacing; foule requires >0.50 m spacing and stakes. White cordon paths permit 10 buds and Guyot simple 8; red/rosé listed ordinary systems permit 8. Extra retained buds depend on an observed fruiting-shoot count at 11-12 leaves. Trellised canopy height is >=0.6 times row spacing. Parcel load is <=10,500 kg/ha for white/rosé and <=9,000 for red. Irrigation is prohibited. The 20% dead/missing-vine trigger feeds the national D.645-4 proportional-yield remedy.
